text:
at some point, u will arrive at the worst time in ur entire life

whenever u get there try and remember the following words

“I’m gonna to find a way to be happy anyway.”

there’s a valid logical premise. if u can be happy at the lows, u should be good at every other altitude. 

but it won’t happen instantly...as u know, happiness never arrives on demand.

u have to keep scrapping and chopping away to unearth it. par for the course when u are bouncing along rock bottom.

it won't be in another human, that's where you've been looking for it previously. loyal friendship is as beautiful as things get but u gotta go even simpler

could be music, could be a book

could be a standard sunrise, or counting grains of sand, or suddenly becoming mesmerized at how the moonlight refracts off ocean waves at dusk

common thread in them all, you stop waiting for God to blow you away with some gigantic surprise, and realize that he’s always been there in the way all these little things are connected.

it'll prob be something where its just u and nature… but it may not be. it could be absolutely nothing, it could be u lost in aesthetic contemplation of the universe, or examining new angles on amor dei intellectualis -- the intellectual love of God.

and u will realize, for maybe the first time in ur life, that u require nothing more at that moment. u have everything u need.

"freedom from desire" is the summum bonum. it is extraordinarily rare.

u aren't really overwhelmed by some new, unique, unfamiliar sensation of happiness…but u recognize: "you know what, I'm about as happy as I've ever been."

simple things.

it will work, u have to get out and move around though.

if u can make this happen, and get it all to “click”...it transforms the way u view the entire complexion of life going forward.

because it flips the worlds narrative upside down.

you stop searching, you recognize that its not a destination. ur current circumstances, high or low, are not what determine whether u can be fulfilled and temporarily free from desire

and then you'll see people chasing a mirage off in the distance, and sort of shrug...like...you ain't gonna find it that way brotha.

once u have been happy at the dead lows, that illusion shatters. it is a huge huge blessing, one of the many fruits borne of pain and suffering.

this entire worldview-shift, or upending of ur perception, is almost impossible to explain in advance...some ppl out there are nodding their heads "yup"...the rest, "this is a bunch of starry-eyed nonsense."

que sera sera

like I said...just file it away. 

u may never know if, and when, you’ll need it… 

🌅
